methodology_lesson_20_new.name: Re-measure cascade layers before continuing — stale state can be reduced cheaply
methodology_lesson_20_new.description: §63 documented 3 SHIP-007 blockers based on 2026-05-11 evidence. §73 re-ran the same bench setup on 2026-05-12 and found 2 of the 3 layers had been discharged by intervening commits (specific PRs not bisected). Lesson: when re-entering a multi-layer cascade after time has passed, ALWAYS re-measure each layer's status before assuming the §-author's threat model is current. ~5 min of re-measurement saved possibly 5-10 PRs of unnecessary work on Layer 1 (FP8 warmup) and Layer 3 (throughput optimization). The remaining work scope drops from 5-10 PRs / 1-2 weeks to 3-5 PRs / 3-5 days.
